about_short_description.short_description: Sirdab offers supply chain management, warehousing, and logistics solutions.

product.name: Warehousing
product.description: Provides flexible storage solutions including dry, ambient, chilled, and frozen warehousing with licensed facilities for various sectors.

product.name: Transportation
product.description: Offers integrated transportation services with a versatile fleet for dry, chilled, and frozen goods across cities and regions in Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Customs Clearance
product.description: Manages import and export customs clearance processes across Saudi ports with documentation, compliance, and regulatory support.

product.name: Warehouse Management System (WMS)
product.description: A software platform that optimizes warehouse operations including space utilization, order processing, and billing for 3PLs and warehouses.

product.name: Order & Inventory Management System (OMS)
product.description: A system for managing orders and inventory with real-time tracking, e-commerce integrations, and analytics to streamline supply chains.
